about: The China-hosted models that `rerun --china-hosted` chooses from, by modality.
Each is a model of the catalogue whose provider is in the Alicloud region's allowlist,
rows are the ones the backend's migrations add (V11__model_catalog.sql); a test reads both
files and fails when this list and they disagree.
For each selected recipe with no run on one of these models, --china-hosted adds a run on
the cheapest one of its modality that today's catalogue (GET /v1/models) lists: the price
of one image, or one second of video, with the platform fee. When two cost the same, the
one listed first here is chosen. The models are listed in the order the catalogue was
